Module.Name: rlm-core
Module.Description: Recursive-LM decomposition over live IRIS stores. Answers questions about tables, globals, interoperability message flow and audit logs that are too large, too live or too regulated to export: slice aggregates are computed inside IRIS and only those statistics reach the model, so context grows with slices inspected rather than store size. No %AI.* dependency; talks to any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
